worldcombat.skill.dragonpulse.summary: Gape wide and compress a whole breath into concentric wavefronts that travel along the aim line: the front sweeps through a row of foes and keeps going into whoever stands behind them. The chain form instead gathers at the first foe and runs along the same line through the foes behind it with fading power.
worldcombat.skill.dragonpulse.use.0: Pierce a row of foes lined up on one path
worldcombat.skill.dragonpulse.use.1: Sustain pressure from mid to long range
worldcombat.skill.dragonpulse.use.2: Chain form: run down the same line through the foes behind the first
worldcombat.skill.dragonpulse.descriptio: The wavefront sweeps through enemies along its path, dealing one hit of about %1$s special damage to each target it catches; the wavefront is %2$s blocks thick.
The wave reaches %1$s blocks and advances %2$s blocks per tick.
worldcombat.skill.dragonpulse.chain.on: Chain form: the wave gathers on the first foe it meets, dealing it one hit of about %1$s wavefront damage, then runs along the same line, catching up to %4$s more foes within a %3$s-block half-width band for special damage starting at about %2$s and fading each step (it travels no farther).
worldcombat.skill.dragonpulse.chain.off: Pierce form: it passes through up to %1$s more foes on the line.
worldcombat.skill.dragonpulse.timing: Range %1$s blocks, wind-up %2$s, recovery %3$s, cost %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s.
worldcombat.skill.dragonpulse.growth.0: From level %1$s the wavefront power rises to %2$s and the range to %3$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.dragonpulse.growth.1: From level %1$s the wavefront power rises to %2$s, the range to %3$s blocks and pierce to %4$s.
worldcombat.skill.dragonpulse.preference: On: the wave gathers at the first foe, then runs along the same line through the foes behind it with power fading each step (it stops advancing), at slightly lower power and a longer cooldown. Off (pierce form, default): the wave keeps going through whoever stands behind at full power, good for a line.
Beyond this distance it closes in instead of firing. Larger values fire first from further away.
On: prefer the pulse when other foes can be caught on the same line behind the target (may leave a better position to line it up). Off: treat it as an ordinary spell.
